cases.proves_bugs: BUG-862 (the 'completed' half only: a PIT and a CD run that placed objects and ended by Esc are logged 'completed'; the 'cancelled' half is R05 v2 and the 'refused' half is R10 v2)
cases.title: PIT and CD keep placing until Esc, Esc keeps what was placed, and one U takes back only the last pipe
cases.expected: PIT places a first pit, offers the next, takes a second pit; CD places a first pipe, offers the next, takes a second pipe; each Esc ends it with the 'Stopped' line and keeps what was placed: 2 new pits on layer STORMWATER PIT, 2 new pipe objects, 2 flow arrows, 4 IL texts (18.000, 17.900, 17.800, 17.700) and 2 pipe labels; no New Pit or New Pipe window is left open; the Civil log says 'Command outcome: PIT completed' and 'Command outcome: CD completed' and never 'cancelled' for either; ONE U takes back only the last pipe with its two IL texts, its label and its arrow, leaves both pits and the first pipe.
cases.why_not_unit: The run is a chain of real AutoCAD command instances queued one behind another. Only live AutoCAD shows that the next pick really places another object, what Esc keeps and what one U takes back.
not_automated: The second pit and the second pipe are placed with the real mouse (typed text is lost while CE waits at a prompt). The second pipe's length is not asserted (its label read 1 IN 54 in probe PRH1: the click point is not the exact typed point).
The pit label block and the text sizes are not judged (a look item for Codex).

cases.title: CDRENUMBER on the plan: No leaves every pit label as it was, Yes turns the P9 label into P8 and the P10 label into P9 (same blocks) and leaves P1 to P7 and C1 alone, and one U puts every label back
cases.expected: On the untouched copy the plan labels read P1 to P7, P9, P10 and C1, and none reads P8. CDRENUMBER answered C1 then No prints 'Renumber cancelled - nothing changed.' and every label still reads what it read. CDRENUMBER answered C1 then Yes prints 'Renumbered 2 pit(s) downhill to uphill. One Undo restores the old numbers.'; the block that read P9 now reads P8, the block that read P10 now reads P9, no label reads P10 or a temporary id, and the blocks reading P1 to P7, C1 and X1 are unchanged (109E08 still reads P3). One U echoes CDRENUMBER and the P9 and P10 blocks read P9 and P10 again; no label reads P8. Added 29 Oct 2026 (Opus B7 review item 2): after No and after the U, EVERY plan label (all 11 blocks, handle by handle) reads exactly what it read before, and after Yes the X1 block is untouched.
cases.why_not_unit: The network walk runs on the real drawing's pits and pipes and writes every plan label in one live command.
not_automated: A TG mark is not in this fixture, so 'TG untouched' is not checked. Whether the numbering order is right as engineering is Tim's word.
DBMOD before and after the No answer is recorded, not judged (it is already 1 when the copy opens: N15).
